name: Device Simulator
description: Private iPhone, iPad, Apple TV and Vision Pro simulators with task live views and device management. Install, launch, capture, remote-control apps, perform spatial gestures and navigate the viewpoint. Requires Apple Silicon, macOS 15+, full Xcode and matching runtimes. Powered by Baguette.
whenToUse: iPhone, iPad, Apple TV and Vision Pro simulators; app testing, screenshots and recording, TV remote, Vision spatial gestures and camera navigation.

environment.description: Call when creating a device or diagnosing the setup: checks macOS 15.0+ and Apple Silicon, then reads the bundled Baguette, Xcode, installed iOS runtimes and device types. Downloads nothing. With an existing device, go straight to devices. Includes iOS, tvOS and visionOS (xrOS identifiers) runtimes and device types.

devices.description: Call first: list private devices. tasks/thisTask describe selection only; activeTasks/thisTaskActive describe task activity in the last 15 minutes. usage is active/idle/unknown; operation describes running work. Prefer this task’s recent devices. tasks=0 does not mean free; inspect running devices with unknown activity. Listing does not renew activity.

device.description: Manage private devices. create: use runtime/deviceType from environment (7–12 GB); only for a clean environment, another model or isolation. boot: start and initialize (~105 s); inspect state on timeout. screenshot=true adds a settled image. shutdown keeps data; rename keeps data; erase/delete remove data only when requested. Run switch applies; default idle shutdown is 15 min, deferred while viewed or used. Activity records this task’s use for 15 min; renew during long scripts. release ends only this task’s activity, keeping device/App running. Both require task context. Ordinary operations renew automatically; changing selection retains other devices’ activity. This is not an exclusive reservation; worker restart/expiry leaves running devices unknown. Supplemental image failures return screenshot.error. taskBindingError/appContextError preserve device results: check storage, do not repeat operations.

app.description: install: matching-platform simulator .app at absolute appPath. Identical skips; small changes sync; signing/registration changes and Vision-compatible iPad apps install fully. modeReason explains choice; poll same job with install_status (checking includes comparison). info: version/build/fingerprint; appPath adds matchesLocal. Container/comparison errors do not justify reinstall: comparisonError + verification=unconfirmed leaves build unknown. launch: relaunch by default (arguments/env), opens task view (see viewer). appLaunched confirms launch; viewer.previewOpened confirms view; outcome=partial: retry viewer open only. Per-device launches; conflicts wait ≤1 s; BUSY names operation/device/job. screenshot=true adds settled image within budget; screenshot.error keeps results. terminate stops App; uninstall deletes App/data; open_url opens deep links: inspect confirmations. taskBindingError/appContextError keep results; check storage, do not repeat. No source App copy/launch on platform switches.

screenshot.description: Capture the current screen. Supported Cindy hosts attach the image; older hosts, or images still over 130 KB after JPEG compression, return only path: open it with your image tool before acting. Upright as the user sees it, with screen corners and Dynamic Island; by default 1 pixel = 1 view point, so image coordinates go straight to tap and gesture. grid=true overlays a labelled grid; region crops a rectangle; scale 2–3 for detail (divide coordinates by scale).

describe_ui.description: Read the on-screen elements (accessibility tree). Default: a compact list in reading order with role, text, id, frame and center in view points (tap the center directly). Filter with query/role; x,y returns what is under a point; mode=full returns the whole tree. Games and custom-drawn UIs without accessibility get the text read off the screen instead (source=ocr), with positions; use screenshot for icons without text. OCR failure is an error, not evidence that no text is visible. tvOS/visionOS return OCR text lists in every mode (including full and x,y point queries), without accessibility trees or element IDs. Apple TV coordinates are for observation; operate with remote buttons.

tap.description: Real touch tap through the simulator's system touch path: no window, works while the Mac is locked, and the app receives a finger touch. Target an element by text or id (optional role, nth); in games, text matches the words read off the screen. Or tap a view point x,y (if the screen turned since you looked, it asks you to look again instead of tapping the wrong place). count=2 double-taps; duration≥0.5 long-presses. Returns the new elements about 0.6 s later (observe=ui); observe=screenshot attaches a screenshot. Never inject events into the app process. until=text waits for that text to appear (next page, dialog) instead of guessing settle. Vision Pro projects image coordinates into a single-hand pinch selection/hold. Use press remote buttons on Apple TV. settle is 0–5 seconds, default 0.6; use until or wait_for for longer transitions.

gesture.description: Gestures in screenshot view points: swipe from→to or direction; drag after hold seconds; pinch center/from_spread→to_spread; pan from/by. iOS also supports system edge and scroll_to. Vision supports swipe/drag/pinch/pan; use kind=spatial for depth dragging, rotation and camera navigation. Apple TV uses press. observe/until as in tap. Vision Pro: gaze, pinch-drag (depth in metres), two-hand pinch (scale) and rotate (angle in degrees); tilt/pan/orbit/dolly/move/reset camera. from/to/center are screenshot view points. by is [horizontal,vertical] degrees for tilt/orbit or [right,up] metres for pan (two axes only); move uses [right,up,back] metres. Use move or dolly for depth. dolly distance is metres, negative forward. Screenshot again after moving the camera. observe/until as in tap. Uses system input, not App injection. settle is 0–5 seconds, default 0.6; use until or wait_for for longer transitions.

type_text.description: Type into the focused field; verify focus and result. text with auto pastes in regular iOS apps and on Vision Pro; iOS games without accessibility use US key-by-key typing. Force paste or type as needed. type accepts up to 300 US-keyboard characters; tvOS auto/type sends US keys (select English input first); no clipboard or Unicode paste on tvOS. keys accepts Enter, Escape, Backspace, Tab, up, a, cmd+A, shift+Tab; clear=true empties the field first. observe and until work as in tap. Key events can hide the software keyboard. iOS attempts to restore it after 3 seconds; refocus to check. iOS method=touch uses the edit-menu Paste action without a hardware keyboard and cannot be combined with clear=true or keys.

press.description: Hardware buttons: home, lock, power, volume-up, volume-down, action, app-switcher, swipe-to-app-switcher, swipe-to-home, pull-down-to-notification-center, pull-down-to-lock-screen; duration holds it. release-input only releases stuck keys and stops repeats; it restarts nothing and closes no app. Apple TV: up/down/left/right/select/back/menu/home/play-pause/volume-up/volume-down. Vision Pro: digital-crown (home is an alias). Both support release-input.

wait_for.description: Return once a condition holds (up to 90 s) instead of fixed sleeps and repeated screenshots. text or id appears (gone=true: disappears; in games, the text read off the screen); stable=seconds: the screen changes less than tolerance (percent of pixels, default 0.5) for that long, optionally only within region; log=regex: a matching line in the app's log (with bundleId). screenshot=true attaches the screen. If it does not happen: met=false, the reason and the current screen; for game animation, a suggested tolerance. Images use the call’s remaining time budget; failure or exhausted budget preserves the wait result with screenshot.error. Request screenshot separately if needed. goalMet mirrors met; false means the condition was not met, not a passing acceptance check.

capture.description: Record frames before action (tool: tap, gesture, press, type_text, open_url or app_launch; args: its arguments), then for seconds (≤15) afterwards. Deduplicate frames into a time-ordered contact sheet labelled in milliseconds plus frame files. For transitions, animation, toasts and loading; omit action to record current changes. Supported hosts attach sheets up to 130 KB; otherwise open the sheet path with an image tool. Requires fixed orientation, size and panel, checked before/after action and recording; per-frame rotation tracking is unsupported. All stages share this call’s deadline. Capture failure or exhausted time returns captureError (code, message) with action or actionError and execution retained. actionError includes code, message and execution. Inspect executed/unknown outcomes; never blindly repeat the action. The action starts only after a complete first frame and screen confirmation; failure before then returns captureError with execution=not_executed.

set_state.description: Change device state, several at once: orientation; posture for foldables (closed/open/flat or degrees); appearance light/dark; contrast; text_size (Dynamic Type); network (profile name, offline, clear or {latency, bandwidth, loss}; applies to apps launched afterwards); location {lat, lon} or clear; status_bar clean (9:41, full bars and battery, for screenshots) or clear; privacy {action grant/revoke/reset, service, bundleId} to pre-answer permission prompts. Changing a permission terminates that app; set it before launch. All steps and readbacks share the request deadline. applied lists completed fields; failure or expiry stops later steps and returns stateError with field, code, message and execution. Inspect that field before retrying; do not replay the entire request. Screen information after orientation/posture changes is returned only when confirmed within the remaining time; null in current means unconfirmed. orientation, posture and status_bar are iOS-only; other settings depend on runtime support.

logs.description: Read an app's recent log and crash reports. bundleId or process selects it; last_seconds defaults to 120; level error (errors and faults only), default, info or debug; match filters by regex. Includes this device's recent crash summaries for that process by default (exception, reason, crashed-thread frames). If diagnostic reads fail or run out of time, logs are retained and crashesError (code, message) is returned instead of an empty crashes list. crashes=false skips diagnostics.

heal.description: Explicit Baguette repair for iOS 27 input shadowed by Device Hub, using simctl on the private device set. Restarts SpringBoard and terminates running apps; call only after the user accepts that. Try press(release-input) first for stuck keys.

viewer.description: open/close this task’s live device view. open returns previewOpened; confirm it before saying it is shown. close only stops the view; the device and app keep running. User controls: input, file and app installation (may replace an existing app), copy/paste (replaces the Mac or simulator clipboard), rotation, shake, screenshots (Desktop or clipboard), device switching and start/stop (stopping ends apps), and Baguette advanced tools: location and motion simulation, status bar and persistent network conditions, camera input, remote notification injection (may trigger app behavior), accessibility tree, logs and recording export (may contain app private data); map search and tiles go through the plugin's proxy to OpenStreetMap. Tell the user about these before opening; opening runs none of them. Listens on 127.0.0.1 only. taskBindingError/appContextError preserve results; check storage, do not repeat operations. Preview failure: outcome=partial, nextAction; retry viewer only.
